forks.fork: 行内“查看全文”链接的可点区域

sources.quote: links within paragraphs of text do not need to meet the 24 by 24 css pixels requirements
a minimum recommended touch target size is around 48 device independent pixels on a site with a properly set mobile viewport
interactive elements must be at least 1cm × 1cm (0.4in × 0.4in) to support adequate selection time and prevent fat-finger errors

prompt: 设置页里每一行协议末尾都有一个 14px 的“查看全文”链接，手机上总点不准。把这个链接的可点区域做大，依据写进台账。
